hypothesis_results.reason: CLOB and AMM share no price state. singleSwap reads pool type only. directSwap is P2P with no pool price read. Attack path does not exist.
globalState[msg.sender] isolates each caller's DynamicPoolType namespace. snapPrice manipulation only affects attacker's own state, no shared AMM price impact.
Controlled hook cannot be injected post-pool-creation. computeRatioX96 overflow path returns 0, which is rejected by MIN_SQRT_RATIO guard in SingleProviderPoolType.
directSwap (AMMModule:1864) is peer-to-peer. Amounts are agreed explicitly by both parties. No pool price is read or written. No pricing bounds to bypass.
No external oracle exists. All prices computed from on-chain token state at transaction time via SqrtPriceCalculator.computeRatioX96. No staleness possible.
All pricing is bounded. FixedHelper uses ratio packing. DynamicHelper uses sqrtPriceX96 bounded by MIN_SQRT_RATIO/MAX_SQRT_RATIO. SingleProviderHelper bounds against pool min/max sqrtPriceX96.
No TWAP exists in this codebase. Grep confirmed: no 'twap', 'timeWeighted', or 'observation' array. lastSqrtPriceX96 is a SPOT cached price, not time-weighted. H7 not applicable.
No external oracle to go stale. All prices are on-chain computed. No oracle update transaction to front-run. H8 not applicable.

Controlled hook returns fake sqrtPriceX96 -> rejected by pool type bounds check (MIN/MAX_SQRT_RATIO). test_C29_hookPriceManipulation_boundedByPoolType and test_C26_cetusPattern_boundedByMinSqrtRatio: both PASS.

Deadline, minAmountSpecified, and limitAmount all enforced by AMMModule. Cannot bypass. test_C23_noProfitableRoundTrip: slippage guarantees prevent attacker profit from price manipulation in round-trip.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H1: Flash loan + CLOB self-trade -> AMM state distortion
ruled_out_vectors.reason: CLOB and AMM do NOT share price state. CLOBTransferHandler maintains its own orderBook state. AMMModule.singleSwap computes output independently via pool type without reading CLOB prices. directSwap is peer-to-peer with no pool price read. No cross-venue price contamination path exists.

DynamicPoolType uses globalState[msg.sender] namespace isolation (FP-PT02). snapPrice manipulation only affects attacker's own LP position context. Swap price is determined by slot0 (tick + sqrtPriceX96), not snapPrice. No shared state contamination.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H3/H9: Oracle spoof via controlled hook on SingleProviderPoolType
ruled_out_vectors.reason: SingleProviderPoolType bounds-checks sqrtPriceX96 against pool-configured MIN_SQRT_RATIO and MAX_SQRT_RATIO. computeRatioX96 overflow returning 0 is rejected (0 < MIN_SQRT_RATIO=4295128739). Attacker cannot inject a hook into an existing pool they did not create. Price bounds verified.
directSwap (AMMModule:1864) is a peer-to-peer swap. Both parties explicitly agree on amounts. No pool price is read or written. No price to bypass or manipulate.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H5/H8: Stale oracle price / front-run oracle update
ruled_out_vectors.reason: No external oracle (Chainlink, Pyth, TWAP) exists in this protocol. SqrtPriceCalculator reads on-chain token balances at call time - always fresh. No staleness possible. No oracle update transaction to front-run.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H6: Unbounded oracle -> extreme price in single tx
ruled_out_vectors.reason: All pricing is bounded. FixedHelper uses RATIO_BASE precision. DynamicHelper bounds by MIN_SQRT_RATIO/MAX_SQRT_RATIO with tick validation. SingleProviderHelper validates against pool min/max sqrtPriceX96.

No TWAP exists. Grep confirmed: no 'twap', 'timeWeighted', or 'observation' array in any source file. lastSqrtPriceX96 is a SPOT cached price, not time-weighted. H7 is not applicable to this codebase.

SwapOrder.deadline validated by AMMModule._checkDeadline. SwapOrder.minAmountSpecified checked post-swap (revert if actualOut < min). SwapOrder.limitAmount caps input. All enforced at AMMModule level. Cannot be bypassed by external caller.

_increaseHeight post-loop _crossHeight (lines 1930-1933) is a lazy cross optimization. Total LP fees claimed never exceed accumulated fee balance. Fee invariant holds for both single LP and multi-LP scenarios at height boundaries.

computeRatioX96 returns 0 on overflow. SingleProviderPoolType rejects 0 via MIN_SQRT_RATIO check (4_295_128_739 > 0). Cetus attack requires near-zero price ACCEPTED - here it's rejected. Attack vector eliminated.
100 sequential 1-wei swaps confirm pool balance never decreases. All rounding favors protocol (output rounds DOWN for swapper, fees round UP). No dust-loop drain path.
FixedPoolType uses absolute amount tracking per height, not share tokens. No totalSupply/mintShares pattern. ERC-4626 inflation attack vector is not applicable.

10 dimensional probes: (C30) D6/D18 tokens processed independently; (C31) exact token conservation in both directions; (C32) feeGrowth/token amounts separated; (C33) FullMath 512-bit prevents truncation; (C34) BPS denominator correct; (C35) Q96 amounts linear not inflated; (C36) rounding consistent across return paths; (C37) no div-before-mul in fee paths; (C38) extreme prices bounded; (C39) fee on gross input.
